rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Very steep street with homes 8-10 m from the kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 8, 10 and 16 m along the section; no screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed through street; no marked parking, little room beyond the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through street near a junction with a larger road.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in the imagery; no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Mostly open from the north-east; trees shade the west end.

best_section.where: Bunning Street just below the junction, outside the open front yards
